historical_record.description: The Works Progress Administration built the zoo's paths, underpasses, lakes, paddocks and lagoons and its Aviary, Lion House, Pachyderm House, Monkey Island, Small Mammal House, Bear Pits, stone boundary wall, café and pump house — a zoo designed to replace fences with moats.
Recommended for city landmark designation in 2023, on historical, aesthetic and artistic grounds.
